---
title: "GoodWorkflows exploratory analysis"
output: html_document
params:
  run_dir: "../template/gw/runs/latest"
  labkey_base_url: ""
  labkey_folder: ""
date: "`r format(Sys.Date())`"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE)

run_dir <- normalizePath(params$run_dir, mustWork = FALSE, winslash = "/")
if (!dir.exists(run_dir)) {
  stop(
    "run_dir does not exist: ", run_dir,
    "\nSet params$run_dir to template/gw/runs/latest or your run folder."
  )
}

work_dir <- file.path(run_dir, "work")
outputs_dir <- file.path(run_dir, "outputs")
log_file <- file.path(run_dir, "logs", "nextflow.log")

cat("Run dir:    ", run_dir, "\n")
cat("Work dir:   ", work_dir, "\n")
cat("Outputs:    ", outputs_dir, "\n")
cat("Nextflow log:", log_file, "\n")
```

## Nextflow task debugging

For failed processes, inspect `.command.sh` and `.command.err` under `work/<hash>/`.
Use the Python template [`nextflow-work-debug.ipynb`](nextflow-work-debug.ipynb) (see [`../README.md`](../README.md) for venv + kernel setup).
